subject: HealthTech privacy evidence request — cross-border data flows and DPF
messages:
From: Morgan Liao <morgan.liao@healthtech.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@healthtech.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privacy questionnaire: cross-border data flow evidence (RFI)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — HealthTech is keen to move forward but we need to close a few compliance items before procurement can issue an LOI. Attached is a short RFI from our legal & security teams focused on international transfers and safeguards. High level asks:

- Where do customer request/response tokens and logs reside (region)?
- Do you rely on DPF/adequacy mechanisms for EU→US transfers or do you use SCCs/vis-à-vis a DPA annex?
- Can you provide concrete evidence of an adopted DPF binding instrument or alternative transfer risk mitigation (mapping, DPIA, legal basis)?
- Sample executed DPA annex or pointer to executed SCCs for enterprise customers (redacted).

We are on a fairly tight procurement timeline — can you confirm availability of the materials and whether you can provide an executed sample DPA/SCC within two weeks?

Thanks,
Morgan
Morgan Liao
Head of Security Programs
HealthTech Inc.
security@healthtech.com

Attachment: healthtech_rfi_crossborder_070925.pdf (PDF stub)
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Liao <morgan.liao@healthtech.com>, Daniel Park <d.park@procure-healthtech.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Privacy questionnaire: cross-border data flow evidence (RFI)

Hi Morgan / Daniel,

Thanks for the clear list — appreciate the timeline. Short answers up front and then details below:

- Regions: Customer request/response payloads and tokenized logs can be persisted in the region you select (we offer US, EU, APAC regions). By default hosted instances for new customers are provisioned in the region closest to the sign-up; Dedicated/Private deployments stay in-customer-region.
- Transfer mechanisms: For EU→US transfers we support both the EU Commission’s standard contractual clauses (SCCs) via a DPA annex and rely on approved transfer frameworks where applicable. We provide a DPA annex template that incorporates SCCs; where customers adopt our Dedicated or Private options, data residency is enforced and cross-border transfers do not occur.
- Evidence: Attached is a short DPF evidence pack (mapping summary, data flow diagram, and DPIA excerpt) and a redacted sample of an executed SCC bundle used in a prior enterprise engagement.

Attachments included with this email: redwood_dpf-evidence-2025.pdf; scc-sample-executed.pdf; dpa-annex-template-Redwood.xlsx

Proposed next steps:
1) If helpful, we can do a 30-min technical walkthrough this week with Karthik to go through the mapping and logs retention settings.
2) If procurement needs an executed DPA annex, we can provide a pre-filled copy for signature and route it via DocuSign.

I’ll loop Karthik (technical) and Marissa (legal ops) below to coordinate.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Daniel / Morgan — thanks, quick confirmation below and next actions we’ll take immediately.

- Executed evidence: Attached is a redacted executed SCC bundle (scc-sample-executed.pdf) and the DPF evidence pack we referenced. We have a template DPA annex that incorporates SCC language — Marissa will pre-fill the annex with HealthTech-specific fields (company name, contract dates, contact points) and route via DocuSign.
- Timeline: We can have a pre-filled DPA annex ready for signature within 3 business days; typical countersign turns around in 5–10 business days for similar accounts. If you need a fully executed redaction within 7 business days, we will prioritize and escalate.
- Logs retention: By default evaluation logs are retained 90 days in the hosted environment; Dedicated can be configured with customer-specified retention policies (including shorter retention windows). We will include retention and deletion options in the DPA annex, and Karthik will confirm the retention control surface in the upcoming technical walkthrough.

Next steps:
- Marissa will share the pre-filled annex via DocuSign (docusign link above).
- Karthik to schedule a 30-min mapping session (I’ve asked him to propose times).
